title: 2016 HMMT November Theme Problem 1
statement: DeAndre Jordan shoots free throws that are worth 1 point each. He makes \(40 \%\) of his shots. If he takes two shots find the probability that he scores at least 1 point.

solutions.text:
Answer: \(\frac{16}{25}\)
We want to find the probability of making at least one shot. The probability he makes no shots is \(\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)^{2}\), so the probability of making at least one is \(1-\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)^{2}=\frac{16}{25}\).
